context: Hina and Sho count thousand pieces of leaves in the yard.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、葉っぱ、千枚、ありそう。
lines.en: Sho, look — there's like a thousand leaves out here.
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered eight-year-old observation. Quick open, enthusiasm threading through. Soft genuine wonder at the sheer number. No performance, just delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, hesitant curiosity. Six-year-old wondering if this is possible. Quiet interest — not skeptical, just testing the idea. Warm undertone of willingness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Come on — let's do it together.
lines.style: Generous encouragement. Eight-year-old certainty that this will be better if they're a team. Bright, forward momentum. Genuine warmth, no condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: One, two, three, four… this is hard.
lines.style: Six-year-old concentrating out loud. Soft, counting-focused delivery. Slight frustration but not giving up. Honest about the difficulty without asking for rescue.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Eight-year-old reassurance, gentle and true. Spoken to Sho and to herself. Warm closing — the point isn't finishing, it's the doing it together.
